instruction.text: Use multiplication and division to solve the following problems.

atoms.a: If a doughnut costs £1.20, how much do 3 doughnuts cost?
The 28 pupils in class 6A are split into 7 teams. How many pupils are in 4 teams?
For every hour spent on a plane, you get 10 membership points to spend on future flights. How many points would you have after 3 flights, each lasting 2 hours?
For every 100 kilometres a car drives, it uses 5 litres of petrol. How far does the car have to go for it to use 2 litres?
In June, the UK gets an average of 180 hours of sunlight. How many hours of sunlight would be expected in 6 of these days.
Each team at a pub quiz needs to pay £6 to enter. How much does the pub make from 13 teams?
